summary_en: The company raised its interim dividend to 7.00 yen per share from 5.00 yen, and revised upward its full-year dividend forecast to 14.00 yen per share from 10.00 yen. The increases, totaling 4.00 yen per share, reflect strong business performance and the company's commitment to stable shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice Regarding Surplus Distribution (Interim Dividend) and Revision of Expected Year-End Dividend (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
On November 11, 2026, TOSHO CO., LTD. announced increases to its dividend payouts for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The company raised its interim dividend (with record date September 30, 2026) to 7.00 yen per share from the previously forecast 5.00 yen, and revised upward its year-end dividend forecast to 7.00 yen per share, also from 5.00 yen. The combined full-year dividend is now expected to be 14.00 yen per share, an increase of 4.00 yen compared to the previous forecast issued on May 15, 2026.

The interim dividend increase represents a 40% rise from the prior-year interim dividend of 5.00 yen (paid in December 2025) and will be paid on December 8, 2026. The interim dividend totals approximately 245 million yen. Management attributed the increases to strong business performance and the company's policy of providing continuous, stable dividends to shareholders as a core management objective. The company emphasized that balancing profitability growth, financial strength, and shareholder returns remains central to its capital allocation strategy.
